notes.title: Playtests completed... get ready for Wargames Fest!
notes.notes:
[b]U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition playtests have been completed![/b]

Thank you for participating and sharing your feedback! We truly appreciate your time and effort in helping us improve the game.

Based on your feedback, we’ve made several important updates:
[list]
[*] Bugfix for crew member healing mechanics
[*] New missions added 
[*] A lot of bugfixes related to the tutorial, closing dialogues, and using torpedoes.
[/list]
If you have any further thoughts or comments, feel free to send them our way via the feedback questionnaire, which can still be found in the main menu.

Additionally, we are excited to announce that we’ll be participating in the Wargames Fest on Steam! Stay tuned for more details!

Feel free to join our Discord server to stay connected and share your thoughts: https://discord.gg/bVpbxTZwKC

Thanks again, and we look forward to seeing you in the next phase of development!

notes.title: Playtest has just started!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Ahoy sailors![/b][/h1]

Uboot The Board Game Digital Eidtion playtests has just started!

Please send us any comments on the current state of the game using the questionnaire that you will find in the main menu.

In case of any problems with launching the game or its stability, please write to us directly on our Discord server.

Bug Reporting Instructions:
[list]
[*]Please attach your game saves, you will find them in C:/Users/[UserName]/AppData/LocalLow/Out of The Ordinary/Uboot Board Game PC
[*]In case of crashes, please send your log files (".dmp" files from C:/Users/[UserName]/AppData/Local/Temp/Out Of The Ordinary/Uboot Board Game PC and files "Player.Log" and "Player-prev.log" from  C:/Users/[UserName]/AppData/LocalLow/Out of The Ordinary/Uboot Board Game PC)
[*]The greatest help for our team is to provide a short gameplay video (e.g. using obs, fraps) that shows the problem. It is good that such a recording starts some time before the error occurs. However, if you decide not to record - please send screenshots.
[/list]


We also invite you to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/bVpbxTZwKC and share your thoughts!
[url=https://discord.gg/bVpbxTZwKC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!

notes.title: Playtest registration
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Ahoy sailors![/b][/h1]

We are thrilled to invite each and every one of you to join us in the playtest of our game, which focuses on bringing the U-Boot: The Board Game to the digital space. 
Be the first to try out our game in just a few weeks from now. As fellow sailors, we deeply value your feedback and insights, as they will play a crucial role in transforming this game into an exceptional experience.

[b]How to join?[/b]

In order to sign up for the Playtest, you need to select the option "Request Access" on the Steam Game Page in the section "Join the U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition Playtest". When the test is ready, the option will change to "Play Now".

We also invite you to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/bVpbxTZwKC and share your thoughts!

notes.title: Ship's Logbook - 1940.08.03
notes.notes:
[b]Attention! Captain on deck![/b]

At ease, sailor! In today's course we will talk about advantages and disadvantages about submerging and ascent from the underwater. 

Submarines have this nice ability to not only get underwater but also make it back to the surface! Have you ever considered what is happening, why submarines want to submerge in the first place? 

[b]Let’s take it step by step![/b]

First, the commander, in our case, the Captain, must give such an order. Why? In order to avoid detection and be sneaky - this way we can approach enemy ships without being detected! This is a huge advantage on any battlefield, and the sea or ocean is no exception. 

[b]How deep you may ask?[/b]

The answer is - it depends!
Just before submerging, the Captain will order you one of two possible depths. One will be a periscope - it is up to 10 meters or full sumberg - it is anywhere from 11 meters to the durability of a submarine for not being crushed because of high pressure, and it may be different depending on the submarine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/32be3eda71fc478477a445ff7f0121dd0778c2fb.jpg[/img]

[b]Aye Captain, we submerged. What next, then?[/b]

First thing - we cut off Diesel Engines and switch them fully to electricity engines. Traditional engines won’t work underwater. Electric engines have less power, so you must keep in mind that you will be moving slower, but on the other hand, we are now sneaky and we are trying to surprise our enemies, so it is not that we need all that speed anyway.

[b]Captain, then the enemy won’t notice and detect us, while we are submerged?[/b]

It depends, sailor. You can assume that if we are the first to detect an enemy and get underwater - then we should be safe. Until we fire our first torpedo or unless the enemy got planes that could detect us. 

[b]When do we want to be submerged, besides approaching the enemy?[/b]

When we want to avoid the enemy, or just when we sink a precious merchant ship and we want to go away from the destroyers. It depends. We can also make hit and run tactics until all enemy ships are sent to the bottom of the sea.

[b]Captain, after we are out of combat, then can we ascent from the underwater?[/b]
Aye sailor - and then we can breathe fresh air! Nothing tastes as good as fresh air after ascending from the underwater, and trust me on that - you will love the feeling of victory with the perfume of fresh air! You will appreciate that after your first encounter with the enemy! 

The session is over, now go to the cafeteria for dinner, and we'll see you on the next lesson, sailor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/cf3d527358b3e8894ff522139813d35ab2aee517.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ship's Logbook - 1940.08.02
notes.notes:
Communication is the key to conducting effective and precise operations at sea. The primary means of transmitting information on the U-boat is Enigma - a device for encrypting and decrypting messages.

During missions, the headquarters often communicates with us - radio operators receive encrypted messages.
On board, there is a diary of Enigma daily codes - the keys needed to decrypt the message received on a given day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/75061725d7b499f1dec36c04f261572bfef90111.jpg[/img]

Enigma is located in the officer's quarters - this is where strategic messages are transmitted, the current state of operations is reported, and we receive key information about enemy ships or aircraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/3d741e8d8edd9081baa46fa1c618440304cb06a3.jpg[/img]

Enigma has a rotating disc on which the correct daily code must be entered - then we give the order for one of our crew members to take care of it, and after a moment we can read the decrypted message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/4dda74da4c7b252de3badc7f3e8e029ae1fb38dd.jpg[/img]

If not for this information, we would have fallen into a trap - we did not know that the merchant ship on AN 93 had support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/2a7b136626261ac83b19163b656e246e9da0cc12.jpg[/img]
I wonder what we will receive in the message the next day - hopefully, we won't hit any mines...

notes.title: Ship's Logbook - 1940.08.01
notes.notes:
We are starting a series of updates and news showcasing our adaptation of the iconic board game Uboot: The Board Game.

First up is a crew overview and mobilization! Just like in the board game version, you will have 4 roles at your disposal - Captain, First Officer, Mechanic, and Navigator. Each role manages their crew members with different specializations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/7892b2c0733d5393d17f3cbb51d9b3d00f55f5d3.jpg[/img]

Efficient crew management is impossible without mobilization - just like in the Board Game, every order requires the presence of specific crew members in the appropriate section - the mobilization order ensures that the crew properly prepares to carry out the orders given by the captain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/c94b174845050de472b56c5621dd018ec87aaf4e.jpg[/img]

At any given moment, you will have a view of the current order queue, remember that the number of order points is limited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371797/4119d5ddf8dd6f1e953771f93006ef6e14630560.jpg[/img]

At our next meeting, we will talk a little about the available sections and the orders associated with them, but for now, it's time to set sail!
